data.one_liner: A fast and fully-featured terminal emulator widget for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a terminal emulator widget and core engine that supports mobile and desktop platforms. It renders text at 60fps, handles wide characters like CJK and emojis, and integrates with Flutter's shortcut and input systems.
use_when: You need to build an SSH client, local shell, or serial monitor inside a Flutter app.
You require a fast terminal rendering engine that works on mobile and desktop.
avoid_when: You are looking for a general-purpose webview or code editor component rather than a terminal emulator.
strengths: Works out of the box with no special configuration.
Frontend independent (terminal core can work without the Flutter frontend).
Supports IMEs, custom themes, and wide characters (CJK/emojis).
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter >=3.0.0. Just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and instantiate Terminal and TerminalView.
